epics.name: Scope model & effective config
epics.goal: Global / User / Project scopes with precedence, locks and a 'why is this on?' trace

epics.name: Skills management
epics.goal: Searchable list, per-agent enable with shared-root coupling, shadow/lock states, detail view, bulk actions

epics.name: MCP server management
epics.goal: Searchable per-agent matrix with source and ownership, add/edit, health checks, Keychain secrets

epics.name: Add skill flow & sources
epics.goal: Create and import from git or library with source and destination shown; later marketplace, folder, zip

epics.name: Central store & migration
epics.goal: AgenTuna store folder as master copy; scan, resolve, reviewed plan with explicit original handling, apply and undo

epics.name: Safety & trust
epics.goal: Refuse overwrite and stale previews, diff before write, backups, new secrets in credential store

epics.name: Sync, drift & backups
epics.goal: Detect external edits, adopt/restore, sync labels, restore from backup

epics.name: Agents & detection
epics.goal: Detect agents and config paths, per-agent health, custom agents, copy vs link

epics.name: Instructions (rule files)
epics.goal: Edit CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md per scope; render to each agent

epics.name: Project & navigation
epics.goal: Searchable project picker, scope switcher, command palette

epics.name: Presets
epics.goal: Named sets of skills and MCP servers applied per agent or repo

epics.name: Agent-operable CLI
epics.goal: agentuna CLI + skill so agents can manage AgenTuna

epics.name: Remote backup & sync
epics.goal: Private GitHub repo backup, multi-machine sync

epics.name: Update tracking
epics.goal: Update badge for git-sourced skills, optional auto-update

stories.story: As a user I switch between Global, User and Project scope from the top bar
stories.acceptance: Switcher visible on every screen; each scope opens its own Overview

stories.story: As a user I see skill, server and rule counts per scope on Overview
stories.acceptance: Three scope cards with counts, last-edited and lock count

stories.story: As a user I see which scope wins for any item
stories.acceptance: Effective config lists items with scope badge; nearest scope wins

stories.story: As a user I can ask 'why is this on?' for a server
stories.acceptance: Trace shows Global, User, Project, Local with the winning one marked

stories.story: As an admin I can lock a Global value
stories.acceptance: Locked rows show padlock; lower-scope toggles disabled with a reason

stories.story: As a user I disable an inherited server for this repo only
stories.acceptance: Writes one line to project config; User definition unchanged

stories.story: As a user I see all skills with scope, ownership and status
stories.acceptance: Search box and filter chips by scope; table shows source path, ownership and per-agent state

stories.story: As a user I turn a skill on or off per agent, with coupled roots shown as one control
stories.acceptance: Per-agent switch for Claude Code, Codex, omp; shared roots such as `.agents/skills` are one labeled control with the coupled effect explained

stories.story: As a user I see shadowed skills and which copy wins
stories.acceptance: Shadowed row dimmed; detail explains and offers Compare

stories.story: As a user I open a skill and read its SKILL.md
stories.acceptance: Detail shows file, agents, history and shadow note

stories.story: As a user I promote or move skills between scopes
stories.acceptance: Dialog warns when a copy exists; backup kept

stories.story: As a user I act on several skills at once
stories.acceptance: Checkbox selection shows bulk bar: promote, enable, move, disable

stories.story: As a user I delete a skill from a scope
stories.acceptance: Confirm dialog; backup kept; lower-scope copy loads again

stories.story: As a user I see a searchable per-agent MCP matrix with health, source and ownership
stories.acceptance: Filter box matches name, command and URL; one labeled cell per agent; each row shows scope, source path and AgenTuna or native ownership

stories.story: As a user I add an MCP server once for many agents
stories.acceptance: Form: name, transport, command, env, scope, agents

stories.story: As a user I test a server connection
stories.acceptance: Shows tool count, latency and tool names or the error

stories.story: As a user I see a server's health history
stories.acceptance: Last 5 checks, every 5 minutes, failing state with Fix action

stories.story: As a user I edit an existing server
stories.acceptance: Edit form pre-filled; diff shown before save; an external edit since the form opened is detected and never silently overwritten

stories.story: As a user I store tokens in the macOS Keychain
stories.acceptance: Files get ${VAR} refs; value never written to disk

stories.story: As a user I turn a server on or off per agent
stories.acceptance: Per-agent switches on detail and list; native or unmanaged entries offer Adopt or Resolve instead of toggling

stories.story: As a user I sign in to an HTTP/OAuth server
stories.acceptance: Sign in action; tools listed after auth

stories.story: As a user I choose where a new skill comes from
stories.acceptance: Source step: write new, import from git, from library

stories.story: As a user I write a new skill from a template
stories.acceptance: Name, 'use when' line, template; live SKILL.md preview

stories.story: As a user I import skills from a git repo
stories.acceptance: Fetch lists skills; pick several; preview SKILL.md; review names the repo source plus destination store and agent paths

stories.story: As a user I copy skills from another project or scope
stories.acceptance: Source list shows scope or project and counts; Copy or Link; review names source and destination; the source stays read-only

stories.story: As a user I pick scope and agents and see name clashes
stories.acceptance: Scope cards; agent checkboxes show resolved target paths; shared roots are one grouped control with coupled effect explained

stories.story: As a user I review the exact files before creating
stories.acceptance: Review lists files to write and git-stage option

stories.story: As a user I browse a marketplace with install counts
stories.acceptance: skills.sh style tab inside Source step

stories.story: As a user I import from a local folder or .zip
stories.acceptance: Two more source cards

stories.story: As a user I see items that live only in agent folders
stories.acceptance: Rows show 'not in AgenTuna', source path, owning agent and scope; banner with count; unadopted native entries are never overwritten

stories.story: As a user I scan agent folders for native items
stories.acceptance: Scan lists folders and new items with type, scope, source path and owning agent

stories.story: As a user I resolve conflicting copies
stories.acceptance: Side-by-side diff; keep one or keep both renamed

stories.story: As a user I plan what happens to originals
stories.acceptance: Originals stay unless the reviewed plan explicitly selects replacement; per-item source, destination and backup path shown

stories.story: As a user I apply the migration with backups
stories.acceptance: Backups verified first; apply refuses if the plan or any source or target changed since preview and returns to review

stories.story: As a user I undo a migration
stories.acceptance: Restore originals from backups within 30 days; refuse when later external edits would be lost

stories.story: As a user I dry-run a migration
stories.acceptance: Show exact file list without writing

stories.story: As a user I adopt a single native item
stories.acceptance: Adopt opens a review naming source, store destination and original handling; a stale scan is refused

stories.story: As a user I never lose files to a deploy
stories.acceptance: Deploy onto an unmanaged folder or entry fails, names path, offers Adopt or Move aside; a name match never implies ownership

stories.story: As a user I see a diff before any write
stories.acceptance: Diff shown in editor, drift and migrate flows; a diff or plan that went stale blocks apply and reopens for review

stories.story: As a user I get a backup for every file AgenTuna touches
stories.acceptance: Backup path shown; restore from Sync & drift

stories.story: As a user I know the app sends nothing without my action
stories.acceptance: No account, no telemetry; network only on explicit actions

stories.story: As a user I see files changed outside AgenTuna
stories.acceptance: Drift list and banner with what changed

stories.story: As a user I adopt or restore after drift
stories.acceptance: Split diff; Adopt on-disk or Restore AgenTuna version

stories.story: As a user I restore from a backup
stories.acceptance: Backups list with Restore

stories.story: As a user I see sync state for project items
stories.acceptance: Labels: In sync, Project only, Library newer, Project newer; push/pull

stories.story: As a user I see which agents are installed
stories.acceptance: Agents page with path, format, managed counts and items outside AgenTuna

stories.story: As a user I see a one-line health per agent
stories.acceptance: path · N / N managed · N in sync

stories.story: As a user I point AgenTuna at an unfound agent
stories.acceptance: Connect dialog with Browse

stories.story: As a user I add a custom agent by folder
stories.acceptance: Registry entry for any tool; no release needed

stories.story: As a user I choose copy or link per agent
stories.acceptance: Setting for tools that don't follow symlinks

stories.story: As a user I edit CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md for a scope
stories.acceptance: Editor with file list, scope badge, Save, Discard

stories.story: As a user I create a new rule file
stories.acceptance: Dialog: file type and scope

stories.story: As a user I keep CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in sync
stories.acceptance: One source rendered to both files

stories.story: As a user I switch project from a list of all projects
stories.acceptance: Picker lists all folders, scrolls, shows counts

stories.story: As a user I search projects
stories.acceptance: Search box filters and highlights matches

stories.story: As a user I add a project folder or scan ~/Projects
stories.acceptance: Two actions at the picker footer

stories.story: As a user I jump anywhere with a command palette
stories.acceptance: Cmd+K searches servers, skills, files, actions

stories.story: As a user I group skills and servers into a preset
stories.acceptance: Named preset with members

stories.story: As a user I apply a preset to an agent or repo
stories.acceptance: One click; shows applied as 2/7 or ✓

stories.story: As an agent I run AgenTuna from the command line
stories.acceptance: --json commands: list, install, deploy, migrate

stories.story: As a user I install an AgenTuna skill that teaches agents the CLI
stories.acceptance: npx skills add … installs SKILL.md

stories.story: As a user I back up my library to a private GitHub repo
stories.acceptance: Sign in once; token in Keychain

stories.story: As a user I sync my library across machines
stories.acceptance: Conflicts never overwrite my copy

stories.story: As a user I see an Update badge for git-sourced skills
stories.acceptance: Badge when source changed

stories.story: As a user I turn on auto-update for a skill
stories.acceptance: Per-skill or global setting
